register_extension_type_class: register an extension type class with polars for a given extension name
register_extension_type_storage: register an extension type to be passed through as raw storage in polars
unregister_extension_type: unregister a previously registered polars extension type by name
get_extension_type: retrieve the registered extension type class or storage marker for a given name
test_extension_registry: test the polars extension type registry for duplicate registration errors
